### Connected by kindness

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

[Read more][157]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

[Learn more][159]

### Connected by kindness

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

[Read more][157]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

[Learn more][159]

## Adhesive tape solutions
## for all industries and applications.

[ Discover applications ][77]

# **Manufacturer of Technical Adhesive Tapes**

3F is a high-performance **developer and manufacturer of technical adhesive tapes** for a wide range
of applications. Every year, we coat and convert millions of square meters of self-adhesive
materials and supply numerous industries at home and abroad. Since our founding, we have enjoyed
healthy, continuous growth and are the **first point of contact** for a large number of customers in
all aspects of adhesive bonding technology.

Our products include [**Transfer Tapes and Double-sided Adhesive Tapes**][78] with different carrier
materials, [**Foam Tapes**][79] made of different types of foam, [**Single-sided Adhesive
Tapes**][80] sometimes for the construction industry, and [**Adhesive Coatings in Contract
Manufacturing**][81] on, for example, nonwovens or films. 3F adhesive tapes and coatings can be
found in all industries, so our adhesive tape solutions are meanwhile used in all major branches.

Our **customers** include **industrial companies** that process adhesive tapes or use them as an aid
in manufacturing processes, **trading companies** that make our finished products available to
commercial and private end users, or adhesive **tape converters** that purchase semi-finished
products from us and process them into ready-to-sell cut rolls.

## Tape **Variety**

The 3F product portfolio includes, on the one hand, a range of proven and frequently used
[**standard adhesive tapes**][82]. Their **application possibilities are very versatile**, so that
the most diverse customer groups fall back on them.

On the other hand, our **diversity of raw materials** in the areas of **adhesives**, **carrier
materials**, **intermediate carriers** and **release liners** enables us to offer an almost
limitless, modular product system that allows us to respond perfectly to special areas of
application and customer requirements. 

Furthermore, we offer specific adhesive tape recommendations **for many industries**, which have
proven their functions in many years of practical tests and have established themselves as
**qualified [industrial solutions][83]**.

## Tape **Development**

In addition to the production of adhesive tapes, their **development** is an **important focus** of
our service areas. Our specialist Research & Development department is continuously working on **new
adhesives and industrial solutions** for various industries.

We also carry out product developments for special areas of application as part of joint,
constructive projects in **cooperation with our customers** and merge the know-how of various
specialist areas into progressive innovations.

## Good to know:
## How is an **adhesive tape** constructed?

**Adhesive tape** is the term used to describe single- and double-sided **self-adhesive strips or
webs** that are available to the user in various roll formats. Depending on the type of tape, in
addition to the adhesive they also contain carriers and intermediate carriers as well as release
liners that cover the adhesive.

The **uses** of adhesive tapes are **extremely diverse** and can include applications such as
mounting, packaging, surface protection, sealing, insulation, soundproofing, process aid or repair.
The many areas of application also account for the **large number of adhesive tape types**, which
can differ greatly in terms of structure, raw materials and performance.

What are the functions of the various adhesive tape components and which variants are available?

[ Adhesive ][127]

The **adhesive** plays a major role in determining the quality of an adhesive tape, because its
**properties must match the intended use**. Parameters such as adhesive strength, internal strength,
processing temperature, temperature resistance, compatibility with the surfaces to be bonded and
other characteristics are decisive. So the more precisely the requirements for an adhesive are
defined, the better we as an adhesive tape manufacturer can determine the ideal adhesive for your
projects.

[ Carrier, Intermediate Carrier ][128]

The **carrier material** of an adhesive tape **carries the adhesive**, but also has a **functional
task**. Because the many carrier materials with their different properties **give the adhesive tape
character and function**. Ultimately, the application determines whether film, foam or fabric is
used as a carrier, for example. Intermediate carriers are also frequently incorporated, for example
a thread scrim embedded in the adhesive.

[ Release Liner ][129]

**Release liners** end up as a waste product, but they play a **crucial role in the processing of
the tape**. They are usually made of foil or paper and **cover the adhesive layer**. They are
usually coated with a release agent such as silicone so that they cannot form a permanent bond with
the adhesive. The release liner **makes roll winding possible** and with its help the user of the
tape can control when the adhesive film should be exposed.

* ### ADHESIVE TAPE PRODUCTS
  
  ### **ADHESIVE TAPE PRODUCTS, LTD. (ATP) **is a converter and wholesaler
  ### of pressure sensitive self-adhesive tapes and dispensers.
  
  **We only sell to distributors and other converters – not to end-users.**
  
   
  
  ATP offers a broad range of single and double-sided adhesive tapes coated with:
  * Acrylic solvent and water-based adhesives
  * Natural and synthetic rubber adhesives

Adhesive tapes essentially consist of a material cut into narrow strips and coated on either one
side or both with adhesive. There are numerous types of materials used, such as plastics, textiles,
different types of papers, or metal sheets, such as aluminum. Also, adhesive tapes are available in
various shapes and sizes, suited for any application. Numerous types of adhesives are also used,
such as temporary glues, high durability glues or hardening glues.

The main component of an adhesive tape is the glue, which needs to be pressure sensitive to allow
sticking on different surfaces easily. This type of glue was invented by Dr. Horace Day, an American
surgeon, in 1845, while trying to find an effective surgery bonding glue. Oscar Troplowitz, a German
inventor working for Beiersdorf AG, invented a textile patch which had a gluey surface on one side,
named Leukoplast. The first tape dispenser, an ingenious tool which can ease the use of adhesive
tapes, was invented only in 1932, by John A Borden, an engineer working for 3M, a major chemical
company. Scotch tape, the first translucent tape, was developed in 1930, while the first masking
tape was launched in 1925.

Most adhesive tapes work by applying light pressure on a surface and many tapes exhibit
triboluminescence, easily observable in dark rooms. Essentially, light is generated when the tape is
dispensed and applied on the surface. This phenomenon is not fully understood and it is believed
that it is created by small electrical discharges when peeling off the tape.

Here is a list of some of the most common types of adhesive tapes

Pressure sensitive tapes
Abbreviated as PSA, this type of adhesive tape consists of a sticky tape, one sided or double sided,
which is applied by light pressure. The materials used for the tape range from paper, plastics,
films, textiles or cloths, metal sheets or composite materials. The tape is sticky as it is, meaning
that it works without thermal application or any other related chemicals, such as solvents or acids.
A release liner or other release agents are used on the backing of the tape to prevent sticking
before the peeling process.

Water activated adhesive tapes
Known also as gum paper tape or gum tape, this type of tape consists of sheets of Kraft paper with
and added starch glue or animal glue. The tape becomes sticky and adheres to surfaces only after
applying water. Tapes are available in simple layers, double layers or reinforced with fiberglass
filaments. The adhesives used can be asphalt or hot melted polypropylene. Water activated adhesive
tape can be used for closing boxes, envelopes or other receptacles.

Heat activated tapes
This type of adhesive tapes is activated when a heat source is applied. They are extensively used
when sealing boxes and packaging, such as cigarettes packaging. Other types of thermal tapes can be
released when heated. These are used mainly in the semiconductor industry, where special care must
be given to small delicate components.

Adhesive tapes essentially consist of a material cut into narrow strips and coated on either one
side or both with adhesive. There are numerous types of materials used, such as plastics, textiles,
different types of papers, or metal sheets, such as aluminum. Also, adhesive tapes are available in
various shapes and sizes, suited for any application. Numerous types of adhesives are also used,
such as temporary glues, high durability glues or hardening glues.

The main component of an adhesive tape is the glue, which needs to be pressure sensitive to allow
sticking on different surfaces easily. This type of glue was invented by Dr. Horace Day, an American
surgeon, in 1845, while trying to find an effective surgery bonding glue. Oscar Troplowitz, a German
inventor working for Beiersdorf AG, invented a textile patch which had a gluey surface on one side,
named Leukoplast. The first tape dispenser, an ingenious tool which can ease the use of adhesive
tapes, was invented only in 1932, by John A Borden, an engineer working for 3M, a major chemical
company. Scotch tape, the first translucent tape, was developed in 1930, while the first masking
tape was launched in 1925.

Most adhesive tapes work by applying light pressure on a surface and many tapes exhibit
triboluminescence, easily observable in dark rooms. Essentially, light is generated when the tape is
dispensed and applied on the surface. This phenomenon is not fully understood and it is believed
that it is created by small electrical discharges when peeling off the tape.

Here is a list of some of the most common types of adhesive tapes

Pressure sensitive tapes
Abbreviated as PSA, this type of adhesive tape consists of a sticky tape, one sided or double sided,
which is applied by light pressure. The materials used for the tape range from paper, plastics,
films, textiles or cloths, metal sheets or composite materials. The tape is sticky as it is, meaning
that it works without thermal application or any other related chemicals, such as solvents or acids.
A release liner or other release agents are used on the backing of the tape to prevent sticking
before the peeling process.

Water activated adhesive tapes
Known also as gum paper tape or gum tape, this type of tape consists of sheets of Kraft paper with
and added starch glue or animal glue. The tape becomes sticky and adheres to surfaces only after
applying water. Tapes are available in simple layers, double layers or reinforced with fiberglass
filaments. The adhesives used can be asphalt or hot melted polypropylene. Water activated adhesive
tape can be used for closing boxes, envelopes or other receptacles.

Heat activated tapes
This type of adhesive tapes is activated when a heat source is applied. They are extensively used
when sealing boxes and packaging, such as cigarettes packaging. Other types of thermal tapes can be
released when heated. These are used mainly in the semiconductor industry, where special care must
be given to small delicate components.

# The heart of the adhesive tape industry network

## Afera, The European Adhesive Tape Association: We are the voice of the pressure-sensitive
## adhesive tape technology value chain, focusing on technical standardisation, regulatory affairs,
## sustainability, networking, educational events, and market data and trends.


## About us

Afera is known and valued as the go-to community of the European tape industry for addressing key
current and future topics that individual stakeholders cannot tackle alone.

## ABOUT US

Dongguan Aomike Industry Co. Ltd. was established in 2007 and located in Changping Town, Dongguan
City. It has developed into a technical enterprise specializing in the production of various viscose
materials integrating R&D, production, sales and service.

The company mainly produces: Waterproof thin PE foam tape, acrylic foam tape, Double sided PE foam
tape,Double sided PET film tape,Double sided tissue tape, Flame-retardant tape and Transfer tape.
These products are widely used in the bonding fixing and protection of architectural decoration,
automobile manufacturing and automobile decoration and electrical products. optical display
products, furniture and stationery packaging, shoe materials and other fields.

## ATLAS TAPES S.A.

**Who We Are**

Atlas Tapes S.A. is a vertically integrated manufacturer of self-adhesive tapes, headquartered in
Greece and recognised as a leader in the Greek market, ranking among the top European producers in
the industry.

Founded in Athens in 1953 by Christopher Lantzis and his son Takis, Atlas Tapes has evolved from a
family-run business into an international manufacturing company. Today, we export over 90% of our
production and serve customers in more than 70 countries worldwide, supporting demanding packaging
and industrial applications with reliability and consistency.

**What We Do**

At Atlas Tapes, packaging tapes are at the core of our business. We design and manufacture a
comprehensive range of solutions developed to ensure secure sealing, efficiency, and performance
across different packaging conditions and distribution channels.

Our packaging portfolio is based on the main industry-standard backing materials, including BOPP,
PVC, PET, and paper, enabling us to support both manual and automated applications across a wide
variety of package weights, surface types, and environmental conditions.

Alongside packaging, Atlas Tapes also offers masking tapes for professional and industrial use,
developed to deliver consistent performance and clean application in demanding operational
environments.

**How We Work: Integrated by Design**

Atlas Tapes operates as a fully vertically integrated manufacturer. From paper impregnation and film
coating to slitting and converting, every critical step of the production process is managed
in-house.

Our manufacturing facilities in Atalanti, Greece, cover more than 55,000 m² of covered production
area and are equipped with advanced coating lines, impregnation lines, and fully automated slitting
systems. This level of integration allows us to ensure consistent quality, flexibility, and
reliability at scale, while responding efficiently to market needs.

[ See the products ][34]

**Innovation, Quality, Sustainability**

Innovation at Atlas Tapes is driven by real application requirements and long-term partnerships. Our
R&D teams work closely with customers and suppliers to develop adhesive solutions that balance
performance, process efficiency, and sustainability.

Sustainability is embedded in our operations. Atlas Tapes adopts four incinerator burners fuelled by
agricultural biomass, producing 32 million calories per hour of clean, sustainable energy to support
manufacturing processes. In addition, solar panels were installed in 2025, further strengthening our
commitment to reducing environmental impact and increasing the use of renewable energy.

Atlas Tapes operates in compliance with internationally recognised standards and certifications,
including ISO, FSC®, and INGEDE, reflecting our commitment to quality, environmental responsibility,
and responsible paper-based solutions.

**Part of Atlas Tapes Group**

Atlas Tapes is the founding company and core pillar of Atlas Tapes Group, a fully integrated
industrial group active in adhesive tapes and paper-based solutions.

Together with PPM Industries, Swiss Quality Paper, and Trustin Tape, the Group combines
manufacturing expertise, geographic reach, and vertical integration to serve global markets across
Europe, the UK, the US, India, and beyond. Being part of Atlas Tapes Group strengthens our ability
to innovate, scale, and support customers with long-term, reliable solutions.

**A Reliable Partner Worldwide**

With decades of experience, strong manufacturing capabilities, and an international outlook, Atlas
Tapes is a trusted partner for distributors and industrial customers worldwide.

From paper to tape, we own the process.</br

## ALL ABOUT
## TAPES

[masking tapes, packaging tapes]

## ATLAS TAPES S.A.

**Who We Are**

Atlas Tapes S.A. is a vertically integrated manufacturer of self-adhesive tapes, headquartered in
Greece and recognised as a leader in the Greek market, ranking among the top European producers in
the industry.

Founded in Athens in 1953 by Christopher Lantzis and his son Takis, Atlas Tapes has evolved from a
family-run business into an international manufacturing company. Today, we export over 90% of our
production and serve customers in more than 70 countries worldwide, supporting demanding packaging
and industrial applications with reliability and consistency.

**What We Do**

At Atlas Tapes, packaging tapes are at the core of our business. We design and manufacture a
comprehensive range of solutions developed to ensure secure sealing, efficiency, and performance
across different packaging conditions and distribution channels.

Our packaging portfolio is based on the main industry-standard backing materials, including BOPP,
PVC, PET, and paper, enabling us to support both manual and automated applications across a wide
variety of package weights, surface types, and environmental conditions.

Alongside packaging, Atlas Tapes also offers masking tapes for professional and industrial use,
developed to deliver consistent performance and clean application in demanding operational
environments.

**How We Work: Integrated by Design**

Atlas Tapes operates as a fully vertically integrated manufacturer. From paper impregnation and film
coating to slitting and converting, every critical step of the production process is managed
in-house.

Our manufacturing facilities in Atalanti, Greece, cover more than 55,000 m² of covered production
area and are equipped with advanced coating lines, impregnation lines, and fully automated slitting
systems. This level of integration allows us to ensure consistent quality, flexibility, and
reliability at scale, while responding efficiently to market needs.

[ See the products ][34]

**Innovation, Quality, Sustainability**

Innovation at Atlas Tapes is driven by real application requirements and long-term partnerships. Our
R&D teams work closely with customers and suppliers to develop adhesive solutions that balance
performance, process efficiency, and sustainability.

Sustainability is embedded in our operations. Atlas Tapes adopts four incinerator burners fuelled by
agricultural biomass, producing 32 million calories per hour of clean, sustainable energy to support
manufacturing processes. In addition, solar panels were installed in 2025, further strengthening our
commitment to reducing environmental impact and increasing the use of renewable energy.

Atlas Tapes operates in compliance with internationally recognised standards and certifications,
including ISO, FSC®, and INGEDE, reflecting our commitment to quality, environmental responsibility,
and responsible paper-based solutions.

**Part of Atlas Tapes Group**

Atlas Tapes is the founding company and core pillar of Atlas Tapes Group, a fully integrated
industrial group active in adhesive tapes and paper-based solutions.

Together with PPM Industries, Swiss Quality Paper, and Trustin Tape, the Group combines
manufacturing expertise, geographic reach, and vertical integration to serve global markets across
Europe, the UK, the US, India, and beyond. Being part of Atlas Tapes Group strengthens our ability
to innovate, scale, and support customers with long-term, reliable solutions.

**A Reliable Partner Worldwide**

With decades of experience, strong manufacturing capabilities, and an international outlook, Atlas
Tapes is a trusted partner for distributors and industrial customers worldwide.

From paper to tape, we own the process.</br
Simple. Just Stick.

Unlike many tape converters that offer some printed tape along with many other “me too” type

quality printed tape at the most competitive prices anywhere.

corrections to any last minute changes your customer may have.

Adhesive tape solutions are essential in wound care, surgical disposables, wearables, and other
stick-to-skin applications. By working with DermaMed, a medical adhesive tapes manufacturer, you’ll
have peace of mind knowing you’re getting. We also provide expertise in product customization and
product testing.

## Products

Pressure-sensitive adhesive medical tapes have been crafted using advanced technologies to meet the
unique needs of our customers. As the leading adhesive tapes manufacturer, our materials are
comfortable yet reliable enough to provide a secure hold across many healthcare applications.

[View Products][28]

## Capabilities

Leverage our adhesive material knowledge, longstanding supplier partnerships and state-of-the-art
manufacturing to advance your business. Using industry-approved modern technology, we can provide an
extensive range of specialized adhesives materials for various medical applications. As an ISO 13485
certified company, our stringent quality controls, rigorous testing protocols, and commitment to
providing superior customer service make us stand out.

[View Capabilities][29]

## Engineering Solutions

Tap into our team of industry specialists. From product concept to the selection of specialized
materials, we are a ready resource and partner. Our experienced professionals ensure that each
client receives high-quality products with proven results. We will be with you every step of the way
as we create and innovate the next ground-breaking product.

[View Solutions][30]

## DermaMed is a Turnkey Medical Adhesive Tape Supplier

As a reliable adhesive tapes manufacturer, we’re focused on introducing adhesive solutions to the
market that improve wound care, surgical disposables, wearables, and other stick-to-skin
applications. Here’s how we do it.

### [Wovens and Nonwovens][31]

Wovens are known for being extremely strong and long-lasting, making them perfect for applications
that require a durable fabric, such as scrubs or surgical drapes. Nonwovens bring a softer quality
to healthcare fabrics and can provide benefits like maximum absorbency and excellent protection from
bacteria or other contaminants.

### Absorbents

Our absorbent materials are perfect for applications where moisture or bodily fluids need to be
managed. These are designed to protect the skin from excess moisture and provide strong support,
allowing for easy handling and frequent changing of wound dressings.

### Breathable Films

From wound dressings to simple bandages, these films help reduce the risk of infection and improve
patient outcomes with every use. This is particularly helpful in difficult-to-treat areas, such as
sensitive burns or chronic wounds.

### Foams

With their soft surface and cushioning properties, they provide excellent levels of care while also
protecting compromised skin which helps promote faster healing times.

### Laminates

Laminates improve strength and provide a waterproof layer of protection. They can be used in
surgical drapes, gowns and other disposable stick-to-skin medical devices. Laminates used in the
medical industry range from non-woven layers to highly breathable films.

### Polyester Films

Polyester films have outstanding optical clarity and excellent heat resistance. They provide
strength to the device at a very affordable cost.

### Polyethylene Films

Polyethylene films offer superior tear strength and conformability, meaning they can be formed into
any shape easily and retain their form even after being stretched or contorted.

### Transfers Films

Medical-grade transfer films are a free layer of adhesive without a carrier. These materials are
used when conformability and precise application of an adhesive is required for a medical device.
They can be found in wearables and chronic wound care applications.

safety standards. As the adhesive tapes manufacturer businesses trust, we ensure that all our
materials and processes comply with regulatory requirements for medical adhesives. Our production
facilities employ stringent quality control procedures to guarantee industry-leading performance in
every product we produce.

Our absorbent materials are perfect for applications where moisture or bodily fluids need to be
managed. These are designed to protect the skin from excess moisture and provide strong support,

patient outcomes with every use. This is particularly helpful in difficult-to-treat areas, such as
sensitive burns or chronic wounds.

protecting compromised skin which helps promote faster healing times.

surgical drapes, gowns and other disposable stick-to-skin medical devices. Laminates used in the

### Standards

[See All][185]
[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

### Standards

[See All][185]
[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

Corporation**, and we do not tolerate any negligence with that. Right from our inception till now
the success that we have earned as a **Distributor, Trader and Exporter** is the result of our
perseverance, passion and strong business skills. The diverse range of packaging and industrial
products that we deal in consists of **Adhesive Tapes, Polyester Adhesive Tapes, Single Sided
Adhesive Tape, Electrical Adhesive Tapes, Fibreglass Sleeves, Film Rolls, Industrial Paper, Bakelite
Sheets and Rods and many more. **

We have the back of some efficient vendors due to which we never face any problem in meeting with
the requirements of our customers. Our vendors have a whole team of skilful engineers and experts,
who are capable of developing supreme quality goods. Moreover, our company professionals have
established strong relations with our vendors as well as our clients for the better progress of our
company. The guidance of our mentor, Mr. Pragnesh A Shah, has also been a huge support for our
professionals.

Our company is pleased to inform that we export and trade in the market a diverse range of
industrial products. Few of which are listed below:

supported by all in-house quality testing facilities by implementing which our QC personnel are able
to judge the products quality skilfully. They stick by the Total Quality Management norms while
checking the products. Most of our products are extremely durable and reliable as our vendors
utilize the best grade elements in their manufacturing. 

**Why We Are Chosen?**
In the last few years we have seen our company evolve in several aspects and there are various
factors that are responsible behind such fast pace growth of our company. Few of these factors we

* We provide only those goods that are defect free

* We have world-wide reach due to our strong distribution channel

stringent quality standards and is tailored to client specifications. Our customization capabilities
include options for dimensions, raw materials, finishing, length, and width, enabling us to meet
diverse industry demands efficiently.

## почему именно мы

Эластичность

Одна из главных задач при работе с защитными плёнками — добиться идеального результата без проблем и
сюрпризов во время установки.

Это плёнка, которая прощает «ошибки» — даже если вы немного промахнулись при первоначальной
установке, всегда можно скорректировать положение.

Самозаживление без температурной обработки

Верхний слой пленки обладает самовосстанавливающимися свойствами.

Мелкие царапины, появившиеся в процессе эксплуатации или при мойке, исчезают буквально за несколько
минут.

И всё это без использования фена или других нагревательных инструментов — естественное тепло от
солнца или воды достаточно для восстановления поверхности.

Защита от реагентов и пожелтения

Особенно актуально зимой: дорожные реагенты, соль и пескосоляные смеси — частые причины коррозии и
потери блеска ЛКП.

Плёнка KPPF 24 имеет усиленный верхний слой, который не желтеет со временем и стойко противостоит
химическим воздействиям.

Это значит, что ваша работа сохранится в идеальном состоянии даже после нескольких сезонов активной
эксплуатации.

Глубокий глянец и насыщенный цвет

Благодаря высокой прозрачности и глянцевому финишу, пленка не просто защищает, но и усиливает
визуальные эффекты лакокрасочного покрытия.

Цвет становится ярче, глубже, а поверхность — более насыщенной и «живой». Это особенно заметно на
черных и ярких автомобилях, которые получают настоящий «премиум-вид».

## почему именно мы

Эластичность

Одна из главных задач при работе с защитными плёнками — добиться идеального результата без проблем и
сюрпризов во время установки.

Это плёнка, которая прощает «ошибки» — даже если вы немного промахнулись при первоначальной
установке, всегда можно скорректировать положение.

Самозаживление без температурной обработки

Верхний слой пленки обладает самовосстанавливающимися свойствами.

Мелкие царапины, появившиеся в процессе эксплуатации или при мойке, исчезают буквально за несколько
минут.

И всё это без использования фена или других нагревательных инструментов — естественное тепло от
солнца или воды достаточно для восстановления поверхности.

Защита от реагентов и пожелтения

Особенно актуально зимой: дорожные реагенты, соль и пескосоляные смеси — частые причины коррозии и
потери блеска ЛКП.

Плёнка KPPF 24 имеет усиленный верхний слой, который не желтеет со временем и стойко противостоит
химическим воздействиям.

Это значит, что ваша работа сохранится в идеальном состоянии даже после нескольких сезонов активной
эксплуатации.

Глубокий глянец и насыщенный цвет

Благодаря высокой прозрачности и глянцевому финишу, пленка не просто защищает, но и усиливает
визуальные эффекты лакокрасочного покрытия.

Цвет становится ярче, глубже, а поверхность — более насыщенной и «живой». Это особенно заметно на
черных и ярких автомобилях, которые получают настоящий «премиум-вид».

## **Microfluidics Products for Flow and Control**

LabSmith products take the hassle out of research and product development. Our microfluidics
products put you in control of fluid flow, high voltage, pressure, temperature, and imaging—and
coordinate them all from a simple software environment. LabSmith products are trusted in
laboratories around the world, in applications from microbiology to materials. Our products simplify
research and product development, so that you can focus on what matters: science.

[LabPackage Microfluidics Workstation]
[LabSmith Microfluidic Flow and Automation Products]

LabSmith’s compact **[microfluidic components][40]** and **[automation products][41]** assemble
quickly, with low dead-volumes and rock-solid reliability.

**[Microfluidics kits][42]**, and a wide selection of **[microfluidic chips][43]**, give you
everything you need to complete your setups.

If your research includes electrophoresis, our **[high voltage supplies and sequencers][44]** offer
unprecedented voltage control.

And, our unique **[video microscopes][45]** capture elusive events in microfluidic or microbiology
experiments, with triggering and timing based on real-world feedback.

There’s never been a more complete, and affordable, system for creating and controlling
microfluidics.

And, when you need custom microfluidic components, we offer US-based **[precision machining
services][46]** for fast turnaround times.

[**See LabSmith’s Microfluidics Products**][47]
[Two manifold-ready valves attached to a manifold. The view is of the manifold's base.]

## **New Manifold-Ready Valves!**

Eliminate tubing and downsize your footprint with LabSmith’s new high-pressure, low-profile
Manifold-Ready Valves.

These valves are great additions to R&D and embedded instrument applications.

[**Learn More**][48]

## **LabSmith Timing Products**

**LabSmith experimental controllers **have been solving precision timing and synchronization
challenges for over 20 years. These innovative, multi-channel instruments combine the functions of
digital delay generators, pulse generators, clocks, timers, and more. Logic-based signal routing,
real-world feedback and unique timing modes help you tame even the most complex test setups.

[**See LabSmith’s Timing and Synchronization Products**][49]

# #WeProtectYourSolutions

“Siamo gli specialisti nel proteggere e avvolgere le vostre soluzioni e necessità“.

Crediamo nel valore della famiglia, nell’inclusività sociale e in un profondo legame con il
territorio. Per questo negli anni abbiamo lavorato per costruire un ambiente di lavoro positivo e
sereno, attento ai bisogni dei nostri collaboratori e improntato a una costante crescita, personale
e professionale. La nostra visione aziendale pone al centro un capitale umano professionale, formato
e sempre attento ai bisogni dei clienti. Nel 2021 abbiamo svolto più di 300 ore di formazione
rivolte a tutti i livelli aziendali per crescere nella qualità umana e professionale del nostro
servizio e creare un team sempre più performante, motivato e affiatato.

Crediamo profondamente nei valori della fiducia e del rispetto del lavoro, delle persone e
dell’ambiente. Per migliorare la sostenibilità aziendale abbiamo investito nell’installazione di un
impianto fotovoltaico da 150 kw e luci Led in tutti gli uffici e gli edifici destinati alla
produzione, prestando la massima attenzione alle emissioni e al completo rispetto dei limiti di
decibel nei nostri impianti.

Controlliamo ogni fase del processo produttivo, dalla selezione delle materie prime alla
realizzazione del prodotto finito, per assicurare sempre un alto livello qualitativo dei nostri
prodotti Tutta la produzione avviene in Italia, fortemente radicata al territorio bergamasco e ai
valori della tradizione, con uno sguardo sempre rivolto alle sfide future e alle nuove richieste del
mercato internazionale.

Studiamo soluzioni per proteggere i tuoi prodotti, realizziamo film protettivi e nastri adesivi di
qualità, resistenti e studiati per durare nel tempo. Ma siamo anche molto di più: flessibilità,
competitività e velocità nelle risposte, un lavoro di squadra che mira a una qualità sostenibile ed
efficiente con lo scop

#### Double Sided Tape

### 1.Product Overview

Double-sided tape, full name double-sided tape, is a kind of tape coated with high performance
pressure-sensitive adhesive on both surfaces of the substrate (such as non-woven cloth, film, foam,
etc.).

**Core Structure:** usually consists of three parts

**Release Paper/Film: **protects the adhesive surface and is removed during use. Common types
include single-sided and double-sided release.

**Base Material:** the skeleton of the tape determines the thickness, flexibility, tensile strength
and other basic physical properties of the tape.

**Adhesive: **The core function is to bond. The viscosity, temperature resistance, and weather
resistance vary depending on the composition.

**How it Works: **With a slight press, the adhesive creates an adhesive force with the surface of
the object to be glued, thus firmly bonding the two objects together.

**Main Features:** easy to use, fast bonding, no need to wait for curing like liquid glue, clean and
stain free, stress distribution is uniform.

### 2.What are the types

Our products mainly fall into these categories: [Oil-based Double Sided Tape][91], [Hot Melt Double
Sided Tape][92], [Embroidery Double Sided ][93]Tape, etc.



There are many kinds of double-sided tape, according to the different substrate and adhesive, can be
divided into the following categories:

#### 1. Non-woven fabric base double-sided tape

**Base Material: **non-woven material.

**Features:** moderate thickness, good flexibility, smooth adhesion, not easy to deform. It is the
most common and universal type.

**Common Applications: **stationery and office supplies, home decoration (such as hooks, photo
walls), gift packaging, car interior, trademark adhesion, etc.

**Representative:** Most of the most common "double-sided tape" on the market belong to this
category.

#### 2. Paper-based double-sided tape

**Substrate: **use kraft paper or cotton paper.

**Features:** easy to tear, easy to process, cheap, but poor temperature resistance and waterproof.

**Common application: **mainly used on the back of masking tape for shielding and protection during
spraying and baking.

#### 3. PET substrate double-sided tape

**Substrate: **polyester film.

**Features: **thin material, high strength, good temperature resistance, high transparency, chemical
corrosion resistance.

**Common applications: **electronic products (such as mobile phone, tablet screen, battery, housing
fixation), nameplate, film switch, glass bonding, etc.

#### 4. Foam base double-sided tape

**Base Material: **acrylic or polyethylene foam.

**Features: **excellent buffering, sealing and filling performance, can fit irregular surfaces,
strong adhesion.

**Common Applications:** construction industry (such as aluminum plate, stone, metal curtain wall
bonding and sealing), automobile (such as trim strip, rain shield, license plate), home appliances
(such as accessories installation), sound insulation and shock absorption.

3M VHB (Very High Bonding Strength) tape is a prime example of foam tape.

#### 5. Acrylic vs. Rubber

**This is classified by adhesive type:**

**Acrylic Adhesive: **Excellent comprehensive performance, weather resistance (high temperature, low
temperature, aging resistance), excellent solvent resistance, long-term use is not easy to turn
yellow. It is the mainstream of high-performance double-sided adhesive.

**Rubber Adhesive:** high initial adhesion, fast bonding speed, but sensitive to temperature and
solvent, may age and remove rubber for a long time, relatively cheap price. Mostly used in some
daily applications that do not require high durability.

### 3.How to choose

**Choosing the right double-sided tape is key to successful bonding. You can follow these steps to
consider:**

#### **(1)Consider the material to be bonded**

**Surface Energy: **This is one of the most important factors.

High Surface Energy Materials (such as metal, glass, ceramic, ABS plastic): easy to bond, most
double-sided tape is suitable.

Low Surface Energy Materials (e.g., polyethylene PE, polypropylene PP, silicone, Teflon) are
extremely difficult to bond and require specialized adhesives such as modified acrylic adhesives.

**Surface Roughness: **Rough or porous surfaces (such as cement walls, wood) require thicker, more
filling tape, such as foam tape.

#### **(2)Consider the environment**

**Temperature: **Will the adhesive be exposed to high or low temperatures after bonding? The
temperature range of the adhesive must be selected to cover the temperature of the environment in
which it is used.

**Humidity/Water/Chemicals:** Is waterproofing or solvent resistance required? Outdoor use requires
excellent UV and aging resistance. Acrylic glue is generally superior to rubber glue in this regard.

**Indoor or Outdoor: **Outdoor applications require high weather resistance.

#### (3)Consider the stress

**Adhesive method:**

**Permanent Bonding: **requires high-strength, durable tape, such as VHB foam tape.

**Temporary Adhesive: **Use tape with moderate initial tack that removes without residue, such as
some double-sided adhesive for non-woven fabric.

**Force type:**

**Shear Force: **the force of two objects sliding parallel to each other (such as a hook on a wall).
Foam tape is very resistant to shear force.

**Peeling Force:** the force to tear from the edge (such as tearing a delivery box). The tape needs
to have good toughness and initial adhesion.

**Load-Bearing: **How heavy is the object to be bonded? The heavier the weight, the larger the
bonding area required, or the stronger the adhesive tape needs to be selected.

#### (4)Consider other special requirements

**Thickness and Filling Gap: **Need to fill the gap between two surfaces? Foam tape is the ideal
choice.

**Appearance:** Do you want it to be transparent, white, or black? The visibility of the tape will
affect the appearance.

**Ease of Use:** Does it require manual tearing? Does it need strong initial adhesion for quick
positioning?



### Summarize the selection process:

**Select the Base Material:** What should you stick to? (Plastic, metal, glass, wallpaper?)

**Specify the Environment: **indoor, outdoor, high temperature, or humid?

**Analyze the Force:** How much force is required? Is it permanent bonding?

**Comprehensive Selection:** Based on the above three points, select the base material type (foam,
non-woven fabric, PET) and adhesive type (acrylic, rubber).

**One Final Tip:** If you're not sure, the best way is to test it on a small area or unimportant
area, or consult us, who can give you professional advice.

#### Kraft Paper Tape

Kraft Paper Tape, as the name suggests, is a kind of tape made of glossy paper as the base material
and coated with pressure-sensitive adhesive. It combines the excellent characteristics of
traditional kraft paper with modern adhesive technology. 

### The main features include：

**High Strength: **Kraft paper substrate itself has long fiber and good toughness, so that it has
strong resistance to tearing and tensile strength.

**Environmentally Friendly and Recyclable:** The main raw material is wood pulp fiber, which can be
naturally degraded and recycled, in line with modern environmental concepts. Many varieties also use
water-based acrylic glue or hot melt glue, which is more environmentally friendly.

**Aesthetic Simplicity: **The appearance is a natural yellowish brown of kraft paper, giving people
a retro, solid and simple feeling, often used to enhance the taste of packaging.

**Easy to Tear: **Most kraft paper tape can be torn open with your hands without tools, which is
convenient to use.

**Excellent Printability: **The surface is suitable for printing and can be customized with a
company logo or brand identity, making it ideal for brand packaging.

Kraft Paper Tape can be classified according to substrate, adhesive, function and appearance：

**Pure Wood Pulp Kraft Paper Tape:** The most common type, low cost, wide application.

with excellent flexibility and no residue after peeling. It is widely used for crafts, decoration,

#### Double Sided Tape

### 1.Product Overview

Double-sided tape, full name double-sided tape, is a kind of tape coated with high performance
pressure-sensitive adhesive on both surfaces of the substrate (such as non-woven cloth, film, foam,
etc.).

**Core Structure:** usually consists of three parts

**Release Paper/Film: **protects the adhesive surface and is removed during use. Common types
include single-sided and double-sided release.

**Base Material:** the skeleton of the tape determines the thickness, flexibility, tensile strength
and other basic physical properties of the tape.

**Adhesive: **The core function is to bond. The viscosity, temperature resistance, and weather
resistance vary depending on the composition.

**How it Works: **With a slight press, the adhesive creates an adhesive force with the surface of
the object to be glued, thus firmly bonding the two objects together.

**Main Features:** easy to use, fast bonding, no need to wait for curing like liquid glue, clean and
stain free, stress distribution is uniform.

### 2.What are the types

Our products mainly fall into these categories: [Oil-based Double Sided Tape][91], [Hot Melt Double
Sided Tape][92], [Embroidery Double Sided ][93]Tape, etc.



There are many kinds of double-sided tape, according to the different substrate and adhesive, can be
divided into the following categories:

#### 1. Non-woven fabric base double-sided tape

**Base Material: **non-woven material.

**Features:** moderate thickness, good flexibility, smooth adhesion, not easy to deform. It is the
most common and universal type.

**Common Applications: **stationery and office supplies, home decoration (such as hooks, photo
walls), gift packaging, car interior, trademark adhesion, etc.

**Representative:** Most of the most common "double-sided tape" on the market belong to this
category.

#### 2. Paper-based double-sided tape

**Substrate: **use kraft paper or cotton paper.

**Features:** easy to tear, easy to process, cheap, but poor temperature resistance and waterproof.

**Common application: **mainly used on the back of masking tape for shielding and protection during
spraying and baking.

#### 3. PET substrate double-sided tape

**Substrate: **polyester film.

**Features: **thin material, high strength, good temperature resistance, high transparency, chemical
corrosion resistance.

**Common applications: **electronic products (such as mobile phone, tablet screen, battery, housing
fixation), nameplate, film switch, glass bonding, etc.

#### 4. Foam base double-sided tape

**Base Material: **acrylic or polyethylene foam.

**Features: **excellent buffering, sealing and filling performance, can fit irregular surfaces,
strong adhesion.

**Common Applications:** construction industry (such as aluminum plate, stone, metal curtain wall
bonding and sealing), automobile (such as trim strip, rain shield, license plate), home appliances
(such as accessories installation), sound insulation and shock absorption.

3M VHB (Very High Bonding Strength) tape is a prime example of foam tape.

#### 5. Acrylic vs. Rubber

**This is classified by adhesive type:**

**Acrylic Adhesive: **Excellent comprehensive performance, weather resistance (high temperature, low
temperature, aging resistance), excellent solvent resistance, long-term use is not easy to turn
yellow. It is the mainstream of high-performance double-sided adhesive.

**Rubber Adhesive:** high initial adhesion, fast bonding speed, but sensitive to temperature and
solvent, may age and remove rubber for a long time, relatively cheap price. Mostly used in some
daily applications that do not require high durability.

### 3.How to choose

**Choosing the right double-sided tape is key to successful bonding. You can follow these steps to
consider:**

#### **(1)Consider the material to be bonded**

**Surface Energy: **This is one of the most important factors.

High Surface Energy Materials (such as metal, glass, ceramic, ABS plastic): easy to bond, most
double-sided tape is suitable.

Low Surface Energy Materials (e.g., polyethylene PE, polypropylene PP, silicone, Teflon) are
extremely difficult to bond and require specialized adhesives such as modified acrylic adhesives.

**Surface Roughness: **Rough or porous surfaces (such as cement walls, wood) require thicker, more
filling tape, such as foam tape.

#### **(2)Consider the environment**

**Temperature: **Will the adhesive be exposed to high or low temperatures after bonding? The
temperature range of the adhesive must be selected to cover the temperature of the environment in
which it is used.

**Humidity/Water/Chemicals:** Is waterproofing or solvent resistance required? Outdoor use requires
excellent UV and aging resistance. Acrylic glue is generally superior to rubber glue in this regard.

**Indoor or Outdoor: **Outdoor applications require high weather resistance.

#### (3)Consider the stress

**Adhesive method:**

**Permanent Bonding: **requires high-strength, durable tape, such as VHB foam tape.

**Temporary Adhesive: **Use tape with moderate initial tack that removes without residue, such as
some double-sided adhesive for non-woven fabric.

**Force type:**

**Shear Force: **the force of two objects sliding parallel to each other (such as a hook on a wall).
Foam tape is very resistant to shear force.

**Peeling Force:** the force to tear from the edge (such as tearing a delivery box). The tape needs
to have good toughness and initial adhesion.

**Load-Bearing: **How heavy is the object to be bonded? The heavier the weight, the larger the
bonding area required, or the stronger the adhesive tape needs to be selected.

#### (4)Consider other special requirements

**Thickness and Filling Gap: **Need to fill the gap between two surfaces? Foam tape is the ideal
choice.

**Appearance:** Do you want it to be transparent, white, or black? The visibility of the tape will
affect the appearance.

**Ease of Use:** Does it require manual tearing? Does it need strong initial adhesion for quick
positioning?



### Summarize the selection process:

**Select the Base Material:** What should you stick to? (Plastic, metal, glass, wallpaper?)

**Specify the Environment: **indoor, outdoor, high temperature, or humid?

**Analyze the Force:** How much force is required? Is it permanent bonding?

**Comprehensive Selection:** Based on the above three points, select the base material type (foam,
non-woven fabric, PET) and adhesive type (acrylic, rubber).

**One Final Tip:** If you're not sure, the best way is to test it on a small area or unimportant
area, or consult us, who can give you professional advice.

# One of Europe's leading adhesive tape converters

Welcome to ADDEV Parafix, converters of adhesive materials for 50 years

[ Why work with us? ][18] [ View products ][19]
* ## About us
  
  ADDEV Parafix is an adhesive tape converter and distributor. We convert self adhesive tapes,
  foams, films and foils into bespoke components and every year we produce over 350 million
  die-cuts.
  
  As a part of ADDEV Materials group, we offer a unique combination of long developed capabilities,
  the latest in converting technology and close partnerships with world leading adhesive material
  manufacturers.
* #### Industries served
  * Medical materials
    
    Adhesive and speciality medical tapes for a variety of healthcare applications.
    
    [ Learn more ][20]
    [g_content_rows-repeater_items_title]
    [Medical materials][21]

    Soft materials designed to improve the performance and safety of EV batteries.
    
    [ Learn more ][22]

    [EV Batteries][23]
  * Life Safety
    
    Reliable solutions for safety critical applications like smoke detectors.
    
    [ Learn more ][24]
    [g_content_rows-repeater_items_title]
    [Life Safety][25]
  * Electronics
    
    Components for bonding, sealing, cushioning, shielding and insulating.
    
    [ Learn more ][26]
    [g_content_rows-repeater_items_title]
    [Electronics][27]

  materials from world leading suppliers for the highest quality and best performing products.
  
  [ Try our product selector ][37]
  [Looking for a specific product?]
* ###### Supporting you through every step
  
  Whatever your tape conversion query, our team can assist to bring your idea to reality.
  
  [ View resources ][38] [ FAQs ][39]

  * How to Choose the Right 3M Converter for Your Adhesive Tape Project
    [Crop anonymous female with adhesive tape sticking rectangular shaped carton piece on white wall
    at home]
    [How to Choose the Right 3M Converter for Your Adhesive Tape Project][40]

    [Converting 3M™ VHB™ Tapes: From Roll Material to Production-Ready Bonding
    Components]

  * ADDEV Parafix Expands Production Capabilities
    [Close-up view of generative line art on paper using a mechanical plotter, showcasing industrial
    precision.]
    [ADDEV Parafix Expands Production Capabilities][42]
  * Harnessing XY Axis Plotters for Innovative Product Design
    [Close-up view of generative line art on paper using a mechanical plotter, showcasing industrial
    precision.]
    [Harnessing XY Axis Plotters for Innovative Product Design][43]
  
  [ View All News ][44]
* ###### Common questions
  
  Do I need to provide a drawing?
  [Do I need to provide a drawing?][45]
  Do I need to provide a drawing?
  
  This depends on the part required and its complexity. A drawing would always be preferable,
  however, in some circumstances it may be necessary for us to create one and provide it to you for
  approval.
  
  [Do I need to provide a drawing?][46]
  Can I track my order?
  [Can I track my order?][47]
  Can I track my order?
  
  Yes, once your items have been shipped, parcel consignment references/AWB references are available
  on request.
  
  [Can I track my order?][48]
  Do you have a minimum order value (MOV)?
  [Do you have a minimum order value (MOV)?][49]
  Do you have a minimum order value (MOV)?
  
  Yes, please[ contact us][50].
  
  [Do you have a minimum order value (MOV)?][51]
  Do you offer a design and prototyping service?
  [Do you offer a design and prototyping service?][52]
  Do you offer a design and prototyping service?
  
  Yes, we are able to help you with your design; utilise our extensive experience and knowledge to
  create bespoke parts from conception through to final production. 
  
  We can produce prototypes, with or without tooling. Take advantage of our rapid prototyping
  capabilities, including Computer Aided Design (CAD), X/Y axis plotter and laser cutting
  technology. We can also produce prototypes using any of our machines.
  
  [Do you offer a design and prototyping service?][53]
  How do I get a credit account?
  [How do I get a credit account?][54]
  How do I get a credit account?
  
  You can complete and submit our credit application form and we can also send pro-forma invoices
  for speed and convenience.
  
  [How do I get a credit account?][55]

We’re always looking to partner with businesses that share our commitment to quality and customer
service. If you’re interested in becoming a reseller of our Perma floor marking tapes, we’d love to
hear from you.

**As a reseller, you’ll gain access to:**
* Competitive trade pricing
* Marketing support and product resources
* Fast, global shipping
* A dedicated account manager
* Trusted, high-performance products like PermaStripe and PermaRoute

**How to Get Started:**

Join our global network of distributors and offer your customers the very best in industrial floor
marking solutions, get in touch today.

[Contact Us][36]

## Durable, Self-Adhesive Floor Marking Tape

Floor marking tape, designed to apply easily and provide long-term performance. Our range of floor
tapes will suit different requirements and budgets while performing effectively for the required
task.

Industrial floor tape for busy working environments should be easy to apply, robust and easy to
remove should workplace process change. Our floor marking tape can do all of that and more.

We have three versions, [PermaStripe][37], [PermaRoute][38] and [PermaLean][39], all with unique
benefits to suit your workplace and processes. We also produce additional signage to complement our
floor tapes.

We produce all of our industrial floor tapes in various colours, widths, shapes and sizes for
immediate dispatch, so you can choose a system that suits you best. Want a colour, shape or length
we don’t supply off the shelf? No problem, [contact us][40], and we will discuss custom requirements
with you.

If you want to apply by hand, you can, for larger areas, our custom-made [floor marking tape
applicator][41] is available to you.

Want to see the quality of our industrial marking tapes first hand? Order some free samples so we
can show you. We know you won’t be disappointed.

Ready to order? Let our sales team handle everything for you, and your order will arrive as quickly
as we can get it to you.

Are you a floor tape reseller? We have an extensive service to offer you that takes a lot of the
legwork out of the setup.

With our floor marking tapes, you’re buying more than a roll of tape.

  ### [Markets][52]

    commercial aircraft and defense applications.

    Rogers is a leading automotive advanced materials supplier with a wide range of industry
    solutions to power, protect and connect vehicles.
  * #### [Connected Devices][55]
    
    Enabling electronic devices and more to operate interactively or autonomously by use of wireless
    protocols.
  * #### [Footwear & Impact Safety][56]
    
    Advanced material technologies that provide flexible comfort and wearable impact protection.
  * #### [General Industrial][57]
    
    Industrial engineers and designers rely on Rogers’ advanced materials to enable reliability,
    efficiency and performance.
  * #### [Major Appliances][58]
    
    Rogers increases energy efficiency with high quality, performance-optimized power electronics.
  * #### [Medical][59]
    
    Rogers enables high quality patient care in applications ranging from medical instruments to
    patient cushioning and wound care.
  * #### [Portable Electronics][60]
    
    Rogers provides complex and compact electronics with superior fabrication and protection.
  * #### [Printing][61]
    
    R/bak® cushion mounting materials provide shock absorption, compressibility, improved
    registration and reduced dot gain in printing applications.
  * #### [Rail][62]
    
    Solutions to power and protect mass transit rail systems.
  * #### [Wind & Solar][63]
    
    Enabling system efficiency and reliability for wind and solar renewable energy sources.
  * #### [Wired Infrastructure and Data Centers][64]
    
    Materials for applications in data center & wired infrastructure environments.
  * #### [Wireless Infrastructure][65]
    
    Low-loss, high frequency advanced materials with well-controlled dielectric properties to enable
    microwave and RF applications, including mobile networks.

to meet diverse industrial, commercial, and DIY needs. As a top-tier adhesive tape company in China,

versatile nano-coated adhesive tapes. Built on a foundation of sustainability, precision
engineering, and quality assurance, our adhesive tape factory utilizes eco-friendly materials and
advanced manufacturing techniques to deliver reliable performance across global markets.



Customer-centric innovation drives our R&D efforts, enabling custom solutions for unique adhesive
tape applications. With ISO certifications, competitive pricing, and responsive support, we ensure
efficiency and trust in every partnership. Beyond products, we commit to environmental
responsibility and long-term reliability, helping businesses enhance productivity while minimizing
waste. As a dedicated adhesive tape exporter, Runhu ensures flexible supply chains, on-time

Electrical tape is a safety tape for wires, used to cover and insulate a broad range of cables,
wires and other materials that conduct electricity. It’s often referred to as insulating (or thermal
insulation) tape, and its uses in workplace and home settings are widespread.

Silver Shine Adhesive LLP manufactures various PVC tapes. Including electrical insulation, wire

applications.

PVC tapes from Silver Shine Adhesive LLP offer excellent electrical insulation. As we as durability,

Customer Cases
Real Problems. Real Results.

How global buyers solved packaging and manufacturing challenges with TXTAPE solutions.

USA · E-commerce
High-Speed Fulfilment Centre Reduces Tape Failures by 40%
A major US e-commerce warehouse was experiencing carton seal failures on automated packing lines
running at 1,200 cartons/hour. Switching to TXTAPE 48 µm hot-melt BOPP tape resolved the issue
within the first production run.
40% reduction in seal failures · ROI in 3 weeks
Germany · Automotive
Custom Printed Tape Strengthens Brand at Point of Dispatch
A German automotive parts distributor needed tamper-evident, branded carton sealing tape that could
withstand −20°C cold storage. TXTAPE delivered custom-printed hot-melt tape in pantone-matched
colours within 15 working days.
Pantone-matched · Cold-storage certified · 15-day lead time
UAE · Export Logistics
Jumbo Roll Supply Cuts Changeover Downtime for Export Packer
A Dubai-based freight packer was losing 90 minutes per shift to tape roll changes. Moving to TXTAPE
3,000 m jumbo rolls reduced changeover frequency by 70%, saving an estimated USD 18,000 annually in
labour costs.
70% fewer changeovers · USD 18k annual saving

and their team always responds quickly to specification changes.”

Across Every Continent

colours within 15 working days.
Pantone-matched · Cold-storage certified · 15-day lead time

3,000 m jumbo rolls reduced changeover frequency by 70%, saving an estimated USD 18,000 annually in
labour costs.

## Vibac group
## a world leader

[ABOUT US][39]

VIBAC Group is a multinational enterprise and one of the world's leading companies in the **Pressure
Sensitive Self Adhesive Tapes** (PSA) and specialty **Packaging Films** industry (BOPP).

 

With **6 manufacturing plants** across **Europe** and **America**, the Group serves multiple high
demanding industries including Food & Beverage, FMCG, Packaging & Labelling, Transportation &
Logistics, Building & Construction, Automotive Aftermarket, Painting & Decorating, E-commerce and
Home improvement.

 

**LEADING TECHNOLOGICAL INNOVATION IN MASKING TAPE PRODUCTION**

Vibac is the sole international masking tape manufacturer having a **complete integrated process.**

The startup of an innovative **PAPER MILL** consolidates Vibac integrated production process,
assuring prompt and integrated control of the whole production process of **Masking tapes.**
This enhances the ability to deliver superior performance products, heavily improves the
effectiveness of the development process and assures the optimal control of each production step.

Vybond is a U.S.-based manufacturer of high-performance adhesive tapes and bonding solutions,
formerly known as Berry Global Specialty Tapes. Headquartered in Franklin, KY, with manufacturing
facilities in Riverhead, NY and Bristol, RI, Vybond develops and manufactures specialty tape
solutions for a wide range of industries, including Aerospace, Automotive, Medical, Building &
Construction, HVACR and Industrial markets. Vybond’s expansive portfolio includes over 60 years of
heritage from brands such as Adchem, Ludlow, Nashua, Patco, and Polyken. Today, the company services
more than 1,500 customers globally, providing engineered adhesive solutions that support critical
applications across diverse end markets.

What is Vybond?

Vybond is an American manufacturer of specialty adhesive tapes and bonding solutions. Formerly the
Specialty Tapes division of Berry Global, Vybond became an independent company in 2025, backed by
Nautic Partners. The company manufactures tapes under five brand families; Adchem, Ludlow, Nashua,
Patco, and Polyken, from three U.S. production facilities.

What industries does Vybond serve?

Vybond manufactures adhesive tapes for aerospace, automotive, medical, HVACR (heating, ventilation,
air conditioning, and refrigeration), building and construction, general industrial, pipeline,
packaging, and specialty markets.

Where are Vybond products made?

Vybond tapes are manufactured entirely in the United States, at facilities in Franklin, KY;
Riverhead, NY; and Bristol, RI.

What types of tape does Vybond make?

Vybond's product range includes duct tape, foil tape, double-coated tape, double-sided tape,
transfer tape, specialty film tape, single- and double-coated foam tapes, PE film tape, and
specialty backing tapes.

Is Vybond the same as Berry Global Specialty Tapes?

Yes. Vybond was previously the Specialty Tapes division of Berry Global, Inc. In 2025, the division
became an independent company under the Vybond name, backed by private equity firm Nautic Partners.
All legacy brands, products, and manufacturing facilities remain under Vybond.

How long has Vybond been manufacturing tapes?

Vybond's manufacturing roots go back to 1957, when the Polyken plant in Franklin, KY, first opened.
